description: Manage forms, templates, users, roles, attachments, and cloud files in a Yunbiao application space.

fields.label: Instance URL
fields.description: The HTTP or HTTPS origin of your Yunbiao server, without the application space path.

fields.label: Application Space ID
fields.description: The application space number in your Yunbiao login URL.

fields.label: App Name
fields.description: The appName from a third-party application authorization. See https://docs.iyunbiao.com/openAPI/1

fields.label: App Key
fields.description: The appKey from the same third-party application authorization.

fields.label: Account
fields.description: The Yunbiao account authorized for the required templates.

fields.label: Password
fields.description: The account password. Omit when the account is bound as the authorization's default account.

actions.name: batch_save_forms
actions.description: Create or update multiple Yunbiao forms. Inspect errorFormList for individual failures even when the request succeeds.

templateName.description: The template name returned by list_templates.

objectId.description: The existing form ID; omit or use zero to create.

objectVersion.description: The current version returned by get_form; preserve it when updating.

items.description: The complete form with business fields and detail rows. Omit objectId to create; to update, first get_form and preserve objectId and objectVersion.

forms.description: Complete forms to create or update.

inputSchema.description: The forms to save in one template.

actions.name: download_attachment
actions.description: Download a Yunbiao attachment to a usable file transit URL. Use the attachment file ID from get_form.

templateName.description: The template name returned by list_templates.

fileId.description: The attachment file ID, not the form or detail row ID.

fileName.description: The attachment file name including its extension.

actions.name: download_cloud_file
actions.description: Download a Yunbiao enterprise cloud drive file to a usable file transit URL.

templateName.description: The template name returned by list_templates.

anyOf.description: The cloud drive file ID as a string.
The cloud drive file ID as a number.

fileId.description: The cloud drive file ID, not a form or detail row ID.

fileName.description: The file name including its extension.

actions.name: get_form
actions.description: Read a Yunbiao form with its current version, detail rows and attachment references.

templateName.description: The template name returned by list_templates.

objectId.description: The existing form ID returned by query_forms.
The existing form ID; omit or use zero to create.

actions.name: get_role
actions.description: Read a complete Yunbiao role record.

objectId.description: The role object ID returned by list_roles.

actions.name: get_template_structure

actions.name: get_user

actions.name: upload_attachment
actions.description: Upload a file from a URL to Yunbiao, returning an attachment entry to include in save_form. Upload alone does not attach it to a form. Connector upload limit: 64 MiB.

templateName.description: The template name returned by list_templates.

fileId.description: The transit file identifier returned by POST /api/files.

name.description: Optional filename override to send to the provider.

mimeType.description: Optional MIME type override to send to the provider.

file.description: A file uploaded to the local transit file API.

fileName.description: The file name including its extension.

fileType.description: The attachment type, for example pdf or txt.

fileId.description: The uploaded attachment ID, not a form record ID.

attachment.description: Insert this entry into the form attachment table, usually named 附件, then call save_form.

outputSchema.description: The uploaded file and an entry ready for the form attachment table.

actions.name: upload_cloud_file
actions.description: Upload a file from a URL to the Yunbiao enterprise cloud drive. Upload alone does not associate it with a form. Connector upload limit: 64 MiB.

templateName.description: The template name returned by list_templates.

fileId.description: The transit file identifier returned by POST /api/files.

name.description: Optional filename override to send to the provider.

mimeType.description: Optional MIME type override to send to the provider.

file.description: A file uploaded to the local transit file API.

fileName.description: The file name including its extension.

fileType.description: The attachment type, for example pdf or txt.

fileFolderPath.description: The enterprise cloud drive folder path. Omit to use the server default.

inputSchema.description: The source file and cloud drive destination.

fileId.description: The uploaded cloud drive file ID.

file.description: The complete cloud drive file metadata, including owner, fileId and any fields returned by Yunbiao.
